categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Carries the macOS label and addresses a platform-specific runtime failure where select() on macOS returns EINVAL for timeouts over 10^8 seconds.
categories.rationale: Fixes a supported-platform regression on macOS where running bitcoin-cli with -rpcclienttimeout=0 fails immediately with 'Could not connect to the server' due to OS-specific select() timeout constraints.

categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and modifies timeout handling in the utility primitive src/util/sock.cpp.
categories.rationale: Capping the timeout in Sock::WaitMany fixes a regression introduced in rc1/rc2 where very large timeouts overflow select() limits or poll() arguments across callers.
